assets.name: SharePoint Online (GCC High)
assets.justification: Primary CUI document storage. All CUI document libraries reside in SPO GCC High. Sensitivity labels and DLP policies enforced.

assets.name: OneDrive for Business (GCC High)
assets.justification: Individual CUI file storage for authorized users. Per-user OneDrive instances within the GCC High tenant boundary.

assets.name: Exchange Online (GCC High)
assets.justification: CUI transmitted and stored in email. Exchange Online Protection + Defender for Office 365 provide transport security. Email forwarding disabled for in-scope users.

assets.name: Microsoft Teams (GCC High)
assets.justification: Primary collaboration tool for CUI discussions and file sharing. Teams files stored in SPO backend. Guest access tightly controlled.

assets.name: vfsgovevops01 (Storage)
assets.justification: Stores compliance evidence including CUI-derived audit artifacts. CMK-encrypted (RSA-HSM 4096-bit), WORM-enabled containers (audit-logs, compliance-reports, incident-evidence) with 365-day immutable retention. Public access disabled, private endpoint only. Encryption via Azure Storage crypto module (FIPS 140-2 Cert #4536) with CMK managed by Key Vault HSM.

assets.name: vfsgov-kv-prod (Key Vault)
assets.justification: Manages customer-managed encryption keys (CMK) for storage account encryption. Premium SKU with HSM backing, RBAC authorization, purge protection, 90-day soft delete. Private endpoint access only. HSM-backed by Marvell CNN35XX-NFBE HSM module (FIPS 140-2 Level 3, Cert #3718).

assets.name: vfsgov-law-prod (LAW)
assets.justification: Centralized audit log aggregation for all M365 and Azure resources. 365-day retention. Receives Entra sign-in logs, Key Vault audit events, Storage access logs, Subscription activity logs, and Automation job logs.

assets.name: Microsoft Sentinel
assets.justification: Cloud-native SIEM providing threat detection, investigation, and response. CMMC 2.0 Content Hub solution deployed. Connected to vfsgov-law-prod workspace.

assets.name: Defender for Cloud
assets.justification: Cloud security posture management and workload protection. Standard tier enabled for VirtualMachines (P2), StorageAccounts, CloudPosture, and ARM.

assets.name: Entra ID + Conditional Access
assets.justification: Identity provider and access control enforcement. Conditional Access policies enforce MFA (phishing-resistant), block legacy auth, restrict CUI access to browser-only sessions. Break-glass account (breakglass@vfsgov.us) configured with MFA.

assets.name: Microsoft Purview DLP
assets.justification: Data loss prevention policies preventing unauthorized CUI egress across Exchange, SPO, OneDrive, and Teams.

assets.name: Defender for Office 365
assets.justification: Email and collaboration threat protection — anti-phishing, safe attachments, safe links.

assets.name: Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM)
assets.justification: Device and application management. Enforces compliance policies on endpoints accessing the CUI enclave. MAM policies for BYOD VDI scenarios.

assets.name: CMMC L2 Policy Initiative
assets.justification: Azure Policy initiative enforcing CMMC Level 2 controls across all Azure Gov resources in the subscription. Default enforcement mode.

assets.name: vfsgov-vnet-eo (VNet)
assets.justification: Network segmentation boundary for Azure infrastructure. Address space 10.0.0.0/16 with 4 purpose-built subnets (PE, management, identity, firewall). Private DNS zones for Key Vault and Blob storage.

assets.name: vfsgov-nsg-pe (NSG)
assets.justification: Network security group enforcing DenyInternetInbound rule (priority 100) on private endpoint subnet. Prevents any public Internet access to CUI-handling storage and key management resources.

assets.name: vfsgov-automation-eo
assets.justification: Automated evidence collection and compliance reporting. SystemAssigned managed identity with RBAC-scoped access (Security Reader, Log Analytics Reader, Storage Blob Contributor, KV Crypto User).

assets.name: EvidenceOps-Automation (SP)
assets.justification: Service principal for automated evidence collection. Certificate-based authentication (cert thumbprint 4683F3E2..., expires 2028-04-12).

assets.name: breakglass@vfsgov.us
assets.justification: Emergency access account for break-glass scenarios. MFA required, excluded from CA-MFA-All-Users policy to prevent lockout during Entra outages.
